lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or whole-cell sun gradient is visible, but upper basalt planes remain consistently brighter than vertical cliff faces; the numeric aggregate cannot override the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent cliff-top bench counts as buildable; exposed sea-cliff faces count as steep; the gully, talus, broken margins, stacks, and dense rock fields make up the remainder.

crown.method: Median native-pixel outer-foliage width across all four visible gully conifers, measured on the 1254 px source and scaled by 2560/1254; source widths 48, 49, 50 and 53 px.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Flooded the source-raster blue/teal sea from the north and west edges, grew a narrow pale-foam collar, closed pixel-scale gaps, and filled small enclosed wet speckles; the three large dry sea stacks remain unmasked as terrain.

refusalReasons: The source violates the highest-priority lighting rule: broad upper basalt planes are consistently brighter than vertical cliff faces, so the drawing still reveals an upper-light direction despite no cast-shadow field.

Several long cliff sections retain a repeated upright column rhythm and read closer to a palisade than the required strongly irregular weathered masses. The second whole-canvas candidate reduced that rhythm but was rejected because open water reached the east edge instead of continuous land.
openRisks: The water mask overlay and source-scale fringe proxies show close coverage of surf and wash, but no shipped-canvas bake was run because this task is quarantine-only.
The crown census uses manual outer-foliage boxes because the overlapping dark crowns merge under color-component segmentation; the diagnostic overlay records every measured crown.
